units.source_text: 那次音乐会之后，我和库拉巴喀也成了朋友，总而言之先把拉卟带到这位大音乐家的家里去。

en.t: After that concert, I also became friends with Kurabakka, so in any case I first took Rapp to this great musician's house.

units.source_text: 和托喀相比，库拉巴喀生活的更加阔绰富裕。

en.t: Compared with Tok, Kurabakka lived in greater comfort and wealth.

units.source_text: 不过也不说他生活得像资本家嘎尔一样。

en.t: Even so, I would not say he lived like the capitalist Gael.

units.source_text: 他的家里摆满了各种各样的古董——

en.t: His house was filled with all kinds of antiques,

units.source_text: 诸如塔那格拉偶人和波斯陶器之类的，还有土耳其式躺椅，

en.t: things such as Tanagra figurines and Persian pottery, as well as a Turkish-style couch,

units.source_text: 库拉巴喀时常在自己的画像下面和孩子们一起玩耍。

en.t: and Kurabakka would often play with the children beneath his own portrait.

units.source_text: 可今天不知为何，他双手交叉抱着，满脸愤慨的坐在那儿，

en.t: But today, for some reason, he sat there with his arms folded, his face full of indignation,
with scraps of torn paper scattered all around his feet.

units.source_text: 原本拉卟常常和诗人托喀一道儿去拜访库拉巴喀的，

en.t: Originally, Rapp often went with the poet Tok to visit Kurabakka,

units.source_text: 但此时这幅样子可能让他很是惊讶，

en.t: but seeing him like this at that moment must have greatly surprised him,

units.source_text: 今天他只是恭敬的对着库拉巴喀鞠个一躬，

en.t: and today he merely gave Kurabakka a respectful bow,

units.source_text: 就悄悄地坐到房间的角落里了。

en.t: then quietly sat down in a corner of the room.
